messages:
anya: Kicking off customer Mistral adapter stitch now — cust provided LoRA-style delta (cust-mistral-adapt-v2.safetensors). Goal: run quick eval pack on Dedicated int4 path and baseline on hosted 8-bit for comparison.
sam: Nice. Do we have their eval pack (short instruction + QA + safety checks)?
anya: Generated a 200-sample quickpack focusing on instruction adherence and slot-filling. Uploading results as they run.
devon: Heads-up — finetune includes 3 custom special tokens, saw them during tokenizer inspection: <CUST_CMD>, <ENT_ID>, <SYS_TAG>. Could introduce token shift with our base tokenizer mapping.
taylor: Can you paste the token-check command?
anya: `./scripts/token_map_check.sh --base mistral-xl-7b --adapter cust-mistral-adapt-v2.safetensors`
anya: Output snippet: 
```
overlap_pct: 97.9
new_special_tokens: ["<CUST_CMD>", "<ENT_ID>", "<SYS_TAG>"]
likely_token_shift: minor (0.6% token id changes in rare tokens)
```
maria: Minor shifts are ok for most stuff but suck for ids and slot-filling. Recommend remap layer or token-vocab-aliasing during merge.
sam: For int4 path, are we using our fused-kernel quant pipeline or fallback?
devon: Trying fused path first, but LoRA merge into quantized weights is tricky — we should test both: merge-first then quantize vs quantize-first then apply adapter (stitch strategies).
eval-bot: quickpack run finished (stage: base vs merged). Summary: 
```
base (8-bit) -> instr-follow: 0.84
merged (int4 fused-merge) -> instr-follow: 0.76
exact-match on slots: base 0.91 / merged 0.85
avg_response_latency: base 210ms / merged 180ms
toxicity-filter-fails: base 0 / merged 1 (one hallucinated URL)
```
anya: That's concerning — a 8 point drop in instruction-follow. Need root cause: tokenizer remap? merge artifacts? quant noise?
maria: Can we diff logits on a failing prompt? Want to see where softmax mass moved.
taylor: Running `python tools/logit_diff.py --base out_base.json --merged out_merged.json --prompt-id 73` now.
anya: Logit diff shows top token shift mostly around special tokens and commas; slot tokens lost 0.4 logit mass to generic tokens.
devon: Suggest two immediate experiments: 1) remap special tokens in adapter to base vocab ids (aliasing) then re-stitch; 2) run merge-first then quantize with K-L divergence minimization (our quant tool has `--kl-refit` flag).
sam: Also try 8-bit merged vs int4 merged to separate quant vs merge degradation.
eval-bot: Quick run queued: merged-8bit and remap-merged-int4. ETA ~12m.
merge-bot: merge job started: stitch_strategy=alias+reweight, lr_hack=0.0001 (small rescale).
anya: We should also add a tiny calibration dataset of 50 examples with the customer's slot patterns to the quantifier for better range estimation.
maria: Agreed. I can curate a 50-sample calibration set from their training excerpts — will drop in /mnt/cust/calib/cust-zenith-50.jsonl by EOD.
taylor: Remap-merged-int4 preliminary results: instr-follow 0.82, slot EM 0.89, toxicity 0. Baselines: merged-8bit instr-follow 0.83.
devon: Good — aliasing fixed most of the token-shift. Remaining delta likely quantization smoothing. Try post-merge min-rescale trick (scale adapters by 0.75) to reduce overconfident logits.
anya: Will run min-rescale + kl-refit quant. If that reaches within 0.02 instr-follow of base, we can greenlight canary on Dedicated with traffic split 1%. Otherwise fallback to 8-bit for the customer.
sam: Also add an eval checkpoint for safety: if hallucinated links >0 or slot EM drops >0.05 we stop rollout automatically.
merge-bot: canary deployment guard created (metric: instr-follow, slot-EM, hallucination-count).
eval-bot: final sanity run (min-rescale + kl-refit): instr-follow 0.83, slot EM 0.90, latency 175ms, toxicity 0.
anya: Great — meets our threshold. Plan: document stitch steps in repo (PR incoming), push canary to Dedicated region eu-west-1, monitor 6h, rollback flag ready.
maria: I'll notify customer success about canary timing and ask for permission to route 1% traffic.
sam: Nice work. Log next steps and PR links in the onboarding ticket.
anya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboard/pull/472 — includes remap scripts and quant flags.
anya: Tagging @maria for customer comms and @devon for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:
